items.title: Awesome Claude Code
items.content_text: ### Status Lines / Obsidian * [TermaGITchi (⭐12)](https://github.com/TevvvB/termagitchi) by [TevvvB](https://github.com/TevvvB) - A Go CLI that gives each Claude Code session its own creature in the status line, derived by hashing the session id, with one den per git worktree. Where other status-line faces react to what the agent is doing, this one is a stable identity for telling parallel sessions apart, and its expression tracks repository hygiene: uncommitted files, unpushed commits, distance behind trunk and the last test result.\        * [tmux-claude-status-tabs (⭐2)](https://github.com/LiveNL/tmux-claude-status-tabs) by [LiveNL](https://github.com/LiveNL) - Shows each Claude Code session's state in the tmux tab bar, per window: an animated spinner while it works, amber when it waits on input, red on a permission request, green when done. Event-driven via hooks with no polling; catches unreported transitions (Esc, permission grants, stop-hook continuations) with transcript watchers. 260+ test assertions run in CI.\        ### Agent Orchestration / Dynamic Workflows * [Dynamic Workflow Design Patterns (⭐0)](https://github.com/zircote/workflows-plugin) by [Robert Allen](https://github.com/zircote) - A Skill based on [this](https://zircote.com/field-notes/dynamic-workflow-patterns/) extremely well authored article about dynamic workflows. Detailed explanations regarding the Workflow tool and sensible advice covering a range of patterns and anti-patterns.\        ### Memory & Context Persistence / Dynamic Workflows * [faf-cli (⭐35)](https://github.com/Wolfe-Jam/faf-cli) by [Wolfe-Jam](https://github.com/Wolfe-Jam) - Authors and versions CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md from a repository's actual detected stack, so Claude Code's project context stays in sync with the code instead of drifting. One typed source file (project.faf, an IANA-registered media type) is the single origin for every assistant's context file; a deterministic score reports how complete that context is. The file lives in the repo and carries no telemetry.\

### Contents / GUI

*   [1bench](https://1bench.dev/postgresql) - Native cross-platform GUI with first-class Postgres support alongside Redis, Elasticsearch, ClickHouse, Qdrant, and more (Commercial Software).
*   [AI for Database](https://aifordatabase.com) - Chat with your PostgreSQL database in natural language. No SQL needed — get instant insights, build self-refreshing dashboards, and trigger automated workflows based on database changes. (Commercial Software).
*   [Dekart (⭐402)](https://github.com/dekart-xyz/dekart) - Open-source platform to turn PostGIS queries into shareable interactive maps.
*   [OrcaQ (⭐219)](https://github.com/cin12211/orca-q) - A modern, open-source database editor for PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, and more. Features an AI assistant, ERD visualizer, schema diff, and visual role management.
*   [PgStudio (⭐12)](https://github.com/dev-asterix/PgStudio) - Open-source VS Code / Open VSX extension for PostgreSQL management with SQL notebooks, AI assistant, Easy to use code snippets and Full-fledged DBMS with real-time monitoring dashboard.
*   [TablePro](https://tablepro.app/) - Native macOS PostgreSQL client with explain visualization, ER diagrams, and AI assistant. Free, open-source.

### Contents / CLI

*   [pgfence](https://pgfence.com) - Lints Postgres SQL migrations for lock modes and risky DDL, with safe expand/contract rewrites. CLI plus LSP. Extractors for Prisma, TypeORM, and Knex.
*   [pgxcli (⭐72)](https://github.com/Balaji01-4D/pgxcli) - Postgres CLI with autocompletion and syntax highlighting written in Go.

### Contents / Security

*   [pgrls (⭐26)](https://github.com/pgrls/pgrls) - static analyzer for row-level security policies; 36 rules across security, performance, and hygiene with 10 mechanically auto-fixable; includes a semantic policy-diff command for CI gating.

### Contents / Monitoring

*   [pgwd (⭐7)](https://github.com/hrodrig/pgwd) - monitors PostgreSQL connection usage and stale sessions, with threshold alerts, Prometheus metrics, and multiple notification backends.
*   [pgvitals (⭐5)](https://github.com/pgvitals/pgvitals) - collection of 40 read-only diagnostic queries for spotting common performance problems (slow queries, bloat, vacuum lag, lock contention, replication lag, wraparound risk) using only the standard system catalog with no extensions required, plus an optional CLI that aggregates them into a 0-100 health score.

### Contents / Extensions

*   [psql\_bm25s (⭐146)](https://github.com/Intelligent-Internet/psql_bm25s) - PostgreSQL extension for BM25-family lexical retrieval with a native index access method and SQL top-k query APIs.

### Contents / Platforms

*   [neond (⭐129)](https://github.com/matisiekpl/neond) - DX-focused control plane for Postgres with branching, PITR, and S3 durability. Ships as a single Docker container with a web dashboard; positions itself as a `postgres:latest` replacement for non-critical workloads.

### Contents / Utilities

*   [pgFirstAid (⭐532)](https://github.com/randoneering/pgFirstAid) - Easy-to-deploy, open source PostgreSQL function that provides a prioritized list of actions to improve database stability and performance. Directly inspired by Brent Ozar's FirstResponderKit for SQL Server.

### Contents / PaaS *(PostgreSQL as a Service)*

*   [Rivestack](https://rivestack.io) - Managed PostgreSQL with pgvector pre-installed and HNSW-tuned for vector search. Free tier (2 GB, no credit card), flat-priced dedicated instances from $15/month, EU and US regions.

### Contents / Docker images

*   [pglayers (⭐146)](https://github.com/pglayers/pglayers) - Pre-built PostgreSQL extensions as composable Docker layers. 50+ extensions, ready-to-use combined images (full, Azure-compatible).

### Resources / Tutorials

*   [PostgreSQL Access Control](https://andersnasell.gumroad.com/l/postgresql-access-control) - The complete mental model: roles, grants, ownership, membership, policies, and default privileges as an integrated system. PDF + video, \~60 min.

*   [JsonFabrica](https://jsonfabrica.com) - API-first service for realistic synthetic JSON test data from reusable templates: relational batches with referential integrity, seed-reproducible output, and an MCP server for AI agents.

items.title: Awesome Gemini Cli
items.content_text:
### Commands & Extensions

*   [Pickle Rick (⭐453)](https://github.com/galdawave/pickle-rick-extension) - This extension transforms the Gemini CLI into "Pickle Rick," a hyper-intelligent, arrogant, yet extremely competent engineering persona. It enforces a rigid, iterative software development lifecycle through continuous AI agent loops.
*   [Conductor (⭐3.7k)](https://github.com/gemini-cli-extensions/conductor) - Conductor is a Gemini CLI extension that allows you to specify, plan, and implement software features.
*   [Knowledge Delta Skills (⭐2)](https://github.com/sergeyizmailov/knowledge-delta-skills) - Portable `SKILL.md` skills for media buying, frontend, security, research, and skill authoring, each kept to what a frontier model does not already reliably know. Copy any skill directory into `~/.gemini/skills/` and Gemini CLI discovers it.

### Development Tools & Utilities

*   [claude-skills-pro (⭐1)](https://github.com/Hahaknight/claude-skills-pro) - 15 engineering-workflow skills (7-dimension code review, root-cause debugging, bug-catching test generation, behavior-preserving refactor, zero-downtime DB migration; 7 free/MIT) with CN/EN handbooks. Installs into Gemini CLI via the open skills installer: `npx skills add Hahaknight/claude-skills-pro --agent gemini-cli` (install path verified end-to-end in Gemini CLI).
*   [Devie AI Quota Tracker (⭐5)](https://github.com/mathdevie/devie-ai-quota-tracker) - Dashboard and macOS menu bar for tracking AI subscription quotas in one place (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot, and Cursor). Supports multi-accounts, notifications, and session-timer start optimization.
*   [ClawMetry (⭐404)](https://github.com/vivekchand/clawmetry) - Self-hosted, local-first observability and kill switch for coding agents, reading Gemini CLI sessions alongside Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenClaw, Aider, Goose, and others. Reads the session logs the runtimes already write on disk, so there is no SDK and nothing in the request path. Shows sessions, transcripts, tool calls, tokens, and cache-aware cost per session and model; an opt-in emergency stop per session and pre-tool approvals for risky actions. Python, MIT, open-core: OpenClaw and NemoClaw are free, Gemini CLI and the other runtimes need ClawMetry Cloud or a self-hosted Pro license. [Website](https://clawmetry.com)

### API Bridges & Proxies

*   [CLIProxyAPI (⭐49k)](https://github.com/router-for-me/CLIProxyAPI) - Wrap Gemini CLI as an OpenAI/Gemini/Claude compatible API service, allowing you to enjoy the free Gemini 2.5 Pro model through API.
*   [TeamoRouter](https://teamorouter.cn) - Hosted LLM gateway — managed alternative to self-hosted bridges. OpenAI-compatible and native Anthropic endpoints behind one API key; works with Gemini CLI, Claude Code, and Codex directly. Free permanent DeepSeek tiers (V4 Pro 200 req/day, V4 Flash 50 req/day, 1M ctx).
